regime_threats.istihbarat: an ultimatum from the secret archive

patronage.title: Sarne's Demand
text: Sarne laid his contract ledger on the table. 'My papers and my channels are both here, Your Majesty. Shall we discuss the price?' Helena murmurs: 'His broadcasts answer to him.'
This time Sarne is not asking. 'I carry the Palace's voice. I want my new share.' Helena waits by the door, reminding you who owns the papers.
Sarne spoke without opening the file. 'I am not so easy to do without, Your Majesty.' Helena avoids saying how close the broadcasts have drawn to the Palace.
patronage.ignore: Sarne got no answer; the board held its breath.

choices.label: Give him what he wants
choices.text: Sarne got his share. A commission reached the Palace; Veyra kept a copy of the file.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: Sarne gathered the contracts. The next day, his broadcasts sounded different.

choices.label: Build a rival network
choices.text: Leyla grew her independent network. Sarne will remember this.

choices.label: Go to the prosecutors
choices.text: Renn took the holding company's ledgers to court.

budget.title: Quarterly Budget
budget.text: Selin Veyra laid out next quarter's ledger. The ministries' breathing room and the Treasury's remaining days will not fit on the same page.
budget.ignore: The Assembly could not meet; the old balance held.

choices.label: Austerity
choices.text: The Treasury will hold; the institutions will wear down, and the streets will tighten.

choices.label: Balanced budget
choices.text: The deficit and the burden will cancel out; no door will open just yet.

choices.label: Generous budget
choices.text: Institutions and streets will breathe; the Treasury will bear the cost.

choices.label: Palace allowance
choices.text: The books will balance; the Palace's share will slip quietly from the Treasury, leaving a trace.
